purpose: A trailing line without a newline must not advance the committed offset; the same bytes become importable once a newline is appended (ACCEPTANCE X11, DATA-API section 5).
expectation_source: hand-computed from the fixture bytes; offsets measured with python3 on the fixture file itself, not with the importer under test
notes: Appending the newline in three separate writes must still import tailC exactly once, and the offset must never pass an unterminated line.
